title: Portfolio Correlation-Breakdown: Does LLM Agreement Spike Under 'Market Stress' Prompts?

original_idea.body:
# Portfolio Correlation-Breakdown

Borrow correlation-breakdown analysis from finance; define stress vs calm input strata and measure pairwise inter-model agreement per stratum to test whether correlation rises under stress. Inference + correlation stats.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 4: strong chain — diversity collapsing on hardest inputs is exactly when redundancy fails; concrete concentration-risk pathway.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 5: stratify prompts, measure pairwise agreement per stratum; standard tooling.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 5: tightly scoped stress-vs-calm correlation comparison with clear success criteria.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: open models + public prompts, no internal access, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Correlation-breakdown framing applied to LLM agreement appears largely novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: No known study of stress-induced correlation breakdown in LLM panels.
